facts.fact: 救援站：Petra 说好友 Jade 被 cave angler pit 拖走、还在下面，向两名救援员求救
facts.anchor: My friend was dragged away in a cave angler pit.

facts.fact: 救援员女人报价：下到第三层救援费 six hundred，Petra 未预付押金另加 two-hundred-nox
facts.anchor: A rescue fee to the Third is six hundred,” the woman says.

facts.fact: Petra 提出把家里全部 500 nox 积蓄（五 hundred nox）都拿出来给救援员救 Jade
facts.anchor: I have five hundred at home. I can go get it now.

facts.fact: 救援员以付不出钱为由赶 Petra 出门；Petra 骂他们无用，发誓自己下井救 Jade
facts.anchor: “You guys are useless.” I point at the rescuers. “I’m going to save her myself!”

facts.fact: Petra 跑回孤儿院，用 two slow knocks, pause, three quick knocks 的孤儿暗号叫 Ms. Opal 开门
facts.anchor: two slow knocks, pause, three quick knocks

facts.fact: Ms. Opal 从灰围裙口袋掏出一张 ten-nox 钞票塞给 Petra，Petra 说会还她
facts.anchor: She puts a ten-nox note in my palm.

facts.fact: Petra 把采来的 tassala 交给 Ms. Opal，要她做成 lotion 给八岁的 Calcy
facts.anchor: Make it into a lotion for Calcy.

facts.fact: Ms. Opal 警告 Jade 可能已死、劝 Petra 另找 dive partner；Petra 拒绝，坚持回去救她
facts.anchor: You can find a new dive partner, Petra.
